card.name: Resume or withhold until recovery
card.fires_on: The linking word (until, upon, after) that follows a withhold, interrupt, resume or rechallenge instruction and introduces the recovery or resolution condition. Seen in dose-modification tables for adverse reactions.

modes.label: Until
modes.description: "Until" right after a withhold or interrupt instruction naming the drug.
modes.example: Grade 3 or Grade 4 Withhold AYVAKIT<< until>> improvement to less than or equal to Grade

modes.label: Upon / after
modes.description: "Upon" or "after" following a resume or rechallenge instruction, before recovery or resolution.
modes.example: resume at 1 dose level lower<< upon>> recovery. May resume initial dose level when

card.writes: It seems to push toward words that end a condition, such as conclusion or details, and away from "parts" words.
card.plain: It marks the small word like "until" or "upon" that comes before the recovery condition for restarting a held drug.

For Grade 3 or 4 infection, withhold ZYNLONTA<< until>> infection has resolved
Resume ODOMZO at 200 mg daily<< upon>> resolution of clinical signs and symptoms.
